outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed in frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then pulls the door outward; frames 280–310 in image show the door separating from the oven body. By frames 370–399 in image, the door is visibly tilted outward and remains ajar, with wrist_image also showing the displaced glass door beside the gripper. The door is not fully lowered, but opening is visible; no failed acquisition or unintended side effect is established.
